plugins.name: claude-performance
plugins.description: Weekly performance digest for Claude Code. Reads JSONL session data, computes six effectiveness metrics (activity mix, one-shot edit rate, subagent turn count, model mix, project allocation, hookify firings), fires diagnostic rules, and writes behavioral rules into CLAUDE.md so future sessions adapt. Measurement layer for self-improving AI workflows.

skills.name: performance
skills.description: Use this skill when the user says /performance, /digest, asks for a weekly Claude performance report, or wants to review how their Claude Code sessions have been going. Reads JSONL session files from ~/.claude/projects/, computes six effectiveness metrics (activity distribution, one-shot edit rate, subagent turn count, model mix, project allocation, hookify firings), fires diagnostic rules when thresholds breach, and writes behavioral rules into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md so future sessions adapt. Closes the measurement loop for self-improving AI workflows.
skills.description_zh: 读取Claude Code会话JSONL生成每周表现报告，计算活动、一次编辑、子代理轮数、模型、项目分配和钩子六指标，按阈值诊断并将调整规则写至用户CLAUDE.md。
